items.summary: Improve AirPlay runtime detection so the app correctly reflects when AirPlay is actually available vs unavailable, by using the `webkitplaybacktargetavailabilitychanged` event payload to set `isAvailable` true/false (not always true), and keep `isConnected` synchronized with `webkitCurrentPlaybackTargetIsWireless` on initial load and on change.

When the AirPlay route changes (connect/disconnect), automatically recover playback by reloading the current audio source and resuming playback if the user was playing, while preserving the intended track and approximate playback position when possible.

Reduce AirPlay buffering stalls by adjusting the player’s buffering/retry strategy specifically when AirPlay is connected (e.g., more conservative thresholding and/or quicker recovery actions on repeated `waiting`/low-buffer conditions), without regressing non-AirPlay playback.

Add clear, English user-facing messaging in the player UI when AirPlay is connected but audio is not successfully playing (e.g., extended buffering or repeated playback failures), including a one-click action to retry/reconnect AirPlay playback (e.g., “Retry AirPlay” or “Reconnect”).
